display_name: Correctional-Facility & Direct-to-Reader Book Publishing Vault (PLOTIFIC-SAFE-001 / LULU-USPS-001)

entries.title: PLOTIFIC-SAFE-001 Zero-Assumption Mailroom Gate
entries.summary: Fail closed on any unknown or unverified correctional facility before generating or dispatching an inmate book shipment.
rules: If the destination facility is missing from playbooks/facilities/ or has verification_status != 'verified', halt automated fulfillment and return status: 'requires_manual_mailroom_call'.
Enforce each facility's max_books_per_package, lenient_tier ('1', '2', or '3'), address_format_template (including inmate full name and register/ID number), and content_redlines.
Never include promotional flyers, bookmarks, staples, or unauthorized inserts inside facility-bound parcels.

entries.title: LULU-USPS-001 Print & Carrier Lock (White-Label Matte Paperback + USPS Only)
entries.summary: Restrict facility-eligible print editions strictly to Lulu Direct perfect-bound matte 60# uncoated paperbacks shipped exclusively via USPS with a plain white-label packing slip.
rules: Lock physical specification to binding: 'perfect_bound_paperback', cover_finish: 'matte', paper_stock: '60# uncoated'.
Reject forbidden finishes and bindings at validation time: foil, glitter, embossing, spiral, hardcover, gloss_lamination.
Enforce plain white-label packing slip only (plain_white_label_only: true, zero_promotional_inserts: true, zero_staples: true).
Enforce accepted_carriers: ['USPS'] (Media Mail, Ground Advantage, Priority Mail) and block ['UPS', 'FedEx', 'DHL'] at validation time.

entries.title: ADR-025c Unit Economics, Spine Width & Multi-Channel Distribution
entries.summary: Compute exact base-10 spine width, cover bleed, and net margin floors across direct GrabLab + Lulu, IngramSpark, and KDP channels.
rules: Compute spine width as exact base-10 Decimal(page_count) * Decimal('0.002252') for 60# uncoated paper, keeping bleed at '0.125' in and safety margin at '0.500' in.
Deduct Lulu print cost, USPS postage, and payment processing fees using exact base-10 arithmetic and block orders below min_net_profit_margin_floor_usd.
Pair GrabLab CMS + Lulu Direct paperback fulfillment ('14.99' / '16.99') with IngramSpark institutional catalog distribution and KDP outside-reader eBooks ('2.99' / '4.99').
